handoff: Review approves: 107/107 changed integration fixtures load deep-equal to before (eq.ts rerun vs base), replace targets still hit, no old-wording step keys left; 2 minor notes (NOPE prompt text, equivalence.txt holds only totals).

findings.title: NOPE's prompt still names norn-implement while its skills list names norn-nope
findings.detail:
Before, NOPE replaced `skill: norn-implement` with `skill: norn-nope`, so the derived orientation also named norn-nope. Now SOLO carries the explicit `agent: Use the \`norn-implement\` skill.` and the replace changes only `skills:`. The test asserts only doctor's reason (`skill 'norn-nope' is not installed…`, line 420), so the asserted behaviour is unchanged. The fixture is just inconsistent with itself.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Optionally also replace the agent line, so the fixture means what it did before.

findings.title: equivalence.txt holds only the totals, not the before/after pairs the handoff describes
findings.detail:
The evidence file contains only `{checked: 107, same: 107, bad: 0}`. eq.ts also skips changed literals without `steps:`/`start:`. Those are the 18 `.replace` targets, which this review checked by hand.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Reword the Proof line, or save the script's per-literal output.
